title: Low-Sugar BBQ Marinated Steak Tips
description: Low-sugar barbecue-marinated steak tips with Italian dressing provide a healthier option for those with dietary restrictions, without compromising flavor.
ingredients: 2.5 pounds Beef, top sirloin, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/4" fat, all grades, raw

steps.text: Whisk salad dressing, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, and pepper together in a medium bowl and pour into a resealable plastic bag. Add steak tips, coat with marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, preferably 8 hours to overnight.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove steak tips from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade.

Cook steak tips on the preheated grill until they are beginning to firm and are hot and slightly pink in the center, about 5 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees F (60 degrees C).
